name: 7-Zip
summary: A free, open-source file archiver for Windows with its own high-compression 7z format and support for many common archive types.
description: 7-Zip is a long-running file archiver for Windows. It creates and extracts archives in its own 7z format, which is designed for a high compression ratio, and it also works with widely used formats such as ZIP, TAR and GZIP.

It adds commands to the Windows Explorer context menu, includes a simple file manager, and offers a command-line version for scripts and automation. 7z and ZIP archives can be protected with AES-256 encryption.
The official website publishes separate installers for 64-bit (x64), 32-bit (x86) and ARM64 Windows, plus alternative MSI packages for managed deployment.
license: GNU LGPL (most code), with additional terms for parts of the code

features: Creates and extracts 7z archives with a high compression ratio
Works with common formats such as ZIP, TAR, GZIP, BZIP2 and XZ
AES-256 encryption for 7z and ZIP archives
Self-extracting archives in 7z format
Windows Explorer context-menu integration
Built-in file manager

requirements: Choose the installer that matches your Windows architecture: x64 (most modern PCs), x86 (32-bit Windows) or ARM64.
installation_instructions: Open the official 7-Zip download page.
Download the EXE installer that matches your Windows architecture. Most modern PCs use the 64-bit (x64) build.
Run the installer and choose an installation folder.
Right-click a file or archive in File Explorer to use the 7-Zip menu, or open the 7-Zip File Manager from the Start menu.

name: KeePassXC
summary: A free, open-source password manager that keeps your passwords in an encrypted database file you control.
description: KeePassXC is a community-developed, cross-platform password manager. It stores passwords, notes and other credentials in a single encrypted database file that stays on your device or in a storage location you choose, rather than in a vendor's cloud account.

It uses the KDBX database format, so databases can also be opened by other KeePass-compatible applications. Features include a password and passphrase generator, Auto-Type for filling in login forms, and optional browser integration through the KeePassXC-Browser extension.

On Windows, the official download page offers installers and portable ZIP packages for x64 and ARM64 PCs running Windows 10 or 11. A separate legacy installer for Windows 7, 8 and 8.1 is tied to an older release that is no longer supported.

name: Notepad++
summary: A free, open-source source code and text editor for Windows with syntax highlighting, tabs, powerful search and plugin support.
description: Notepad++ is a lightweight source code and text editor built specifically for Windows. It opens many files in tabs, highlights syntax for a wide range of programming and markup languages, and can fold code blocks to make long files easier to read.

Its search tools support regular expressions and searching across files in a folder. You can record macros for repetitive edits, split the window into two views, and extend the editor with plugins installed through the built-in Plugins Admin.
The project publishes installers and portable packages for several Windows architectures on its official downloads page.

name: OBS Studio
summary: Free and open-source software for screen recording and live streaming, built around scenes, sources and an audio mixer.
description: OBS Studio (Open Broadcaster Software) is used to record video and to stream live to supported platforms. You build scenes from sources such as screen and window capture, webcams, images, browser sources and audio inputs, then switch between them while recording or streaming.

It includes an audio mixer with per-source filters, a studio mode for previewing scenes before they go live, configurable hotkeys and support for third-party plugins. Hardware-accelerated encoding is available on supported graphics cards.
Recording and streaming are demanding tasks, so check the official release notes and your graphics driver version before upgrading.

name: ShareX
summary: A free, open-source screen capture, screen recording and file-sharing tool for Windows with configurable after-capture workflows.
description: ShareX captures your screen in many ways: a selected region, a window, the full screen or a scrolling page. It can also record the screen as a video or animated GIF.

After each capture, ShareX can run a sequence of actions that you configure, such as annotating the image, copying it to the clipboard, saving it, or uploading it to one of many supported services. It also includes extra tools like a colour picker, screen ruler and text recognition (OCR).
Because ShareX is highly configurable, it suits both quick everyday screenshots and repeatable documentation workflows.
